peer.hint: Bring two devices in line with one QR code, no account needed.
peer.title: Sync
peer.intro: Open this screen on both devices. One device shows a code, the other scans it. Then they exchange everything and end up with the same notes. Both devices need internet; they do not need to be on the same Wi-Fi.
peer.hostHint: Choose this on the device with the biggest screen, e.g. the laptop.
peer.joinHint: Choose this on the device with a rear camera, e.g. the phone.
peer.privacy: Your notes are encrypted on your device and passed on via the free service ntfy.sh. The key is only in the QR code, so ntfy.sh cannot read anything. The encrypted files disappear there within 3 hours.
peer.doneHint: The other device merges your notes too and shows "Done" there itself.
peer.settingsLocal: Settings are not synced; they stay per device.
peer.showCodeHint: Scan this code with the other device (choose "Scan code" there).
peer.scanHint: Point the camera at the code on the other device.
peer.progress.downloading: Fetching notes from the other device…
peer.error.offline: No internet. Syncing only works with an internet connection.
peer.error.timeout: The other device did not respond. Did it scan the code, and does it have internet?
peer.error.wrongKey: The data could not be decrypted. Scan a new code and try again.
peer.error.tooLarge: Too much data to pass on at once. Use Export/Import.
peer.error.service: The relay service (ntfy.sh) cannot be reached right now. Try again later, or use Export/Import.
peer.cameraDenied: No camera access. Allow the camera in the browser, or paste the code below.
peer.cameraNone: No camera found. Let the other device share the code as text and paste it below.
peer.badCode: This is not a valid code for this step.
peer.error.badCode: The code could not be read. Please try again.
peer.error.newerVersion: The other device has a newer version of PlaceLog. Update this app first (close and reopen it).
peer.error.notPlekboek: The other device sent unknown data.
peer.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
install.title: Install app
install.banner: Install PlaceLog for quick access and offline use.
install.hint: Put PlaceLog on your home screen or in the Start menu. It then also works offline in its own window.
install.iosTitle: Add PlaceLog to your Home Screen
install.iosWarning: Note: Safari and the installed app keep their data separately. So install before you create notes.
